name: Interrogation room
desc: Two people, one table, and the truth being levered out of one of them.
tags: interrogation room, steel table bolted to the floor, two metal chairs, one way mirror, painted breeze block wall, concrete floor, single lamp hanging over the table, wall clock, camera high in the corner, closed steel door, manila folder on the table
prose: a bare interrogation room, a steel table bolted to the floor between two chairs, a one way mirror set into a painted block wall and a single lamp hanging low over the tabletop
note: Emptiness is the design, so this is the card where you resist adding nouns: every extra object - a plant, a shelf, a window - turns it back into a meeting room. The one way mirror is the single identifying feature; drop it and you have an office. Windowless, so time of day is genuinely unreadable in frame and has to come from the look or from the surrounding scene.
